units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:11:5">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>עד דלא תִצְנַן</he> before she cools off (her throes of birth die away); (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:6">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>שמא תיצון ותמות</he> lest she get cold and die).

senses.gloss: to make cold. Y. Sabb. IV, 6ᵈ [read:] ההן חלא מרתיח רתחא ומַצֵּין צוננה sand heats a warm object buried in it, and makes a cold object colder.

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 129a:9">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>ואִצְטַנִּיאַת</he> (missing in Mss. M. a. O., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 80, 90) she got chills.
